# Provider samples

The JSON files are real responses captured using `claude-opus-5-5` and
`gemini-embedding-2` (1536 dimensions). Tests run offline without API keys.

The mock ID photo is a generated specimen containing fictional data. Its caption
must flag personal data and contain only a generic document description.

The local umbrella and backpack images were obtained from the web with unknown
licenses. Those originals and resized copies are excluded from version control.
Replace them with your own staged photos before distributing a photo dataset.
Their saved provider captions contain textual item descriptions, not the images.
